killedBy: vendored third-party source (issue #771) quotes the fdlibm notice from the source, identical in every fdlibm file
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md is generated, not hand-edited matches what renderNotices() produces right now -- run `npm run notices` to fix
why: An off-by-one in the header extraction quotes the fdlibm `=====` rule into the notice. The rendered notice would still contain the permission text, so a contains-check alone passes; the notice must start at the copyright line.
